body: This movie is simply fantastic, the chemistry was good between hero and heroine, debutant director madhan took a classic movie, Climax was so good..... One of the Best movie in 2026 I have ever seen, The nostalgic love in school days scenes was amazing in this movie, heroine acted the roll so well..

I just finished watching With Love, and it truly left me with a light heart; it is the definition of a "feel-good" movie.

Abishan delivers a solid debut, showing great potential in several important scenes where his facial expressions really hit the mark, but Anaswara Rajan steals the show with a separate, standout performance. Her natural and expressive acting made her character and her school-time love story resonate with me even more than hero's love story.

While the pacing feels a bit slow at times and the story follows a predictable path, the supporting cast is excellent, and the music serves as the film's main pillar, perfectly enhancing the romantic atmosphere.

A personal highlight was finally seeing a visual justification that truly does justice to Deva's iconic song "Aval Varuvala." Despite its minor flaws, it's a beautiful, nostalgic watch for anyone craving a heartwarming love story.

Debutant director Madhan totally nailed hooking us with that nostalgic first-love vibe. Sure, some situations feel familiar and the ending's predictable, but damn, the bittersweet charm worked for me big time.

Abishan does a decent job as the lead, Anaswara is beautiful as always, but you can spot echoes of her past Malayalam roles-mostly cause of her dubbing, which has that thick Malayali-Tamil slang and accent.

The film's packed with great moments, and that ice cream shop scene - Absolute standout - one of the best in recent movies. Kavya Anil owns it with her dialogues and expressions.

Overall, it's a pleasant watch if you're craving a trip back to school days and first crushes.

If u have a crush in your childhood school time and never confessed it's a proper feeling of that time .... seriously absolute rom com from mollywood cinema .. If u have enough time pls watch it once it will give a good feel and full on entrainment and acting of all character is absolutely good so watch it once.

On paper, this movie follows a familiar rom-com setup: a boy and a girl meet, slowly grow closer, and struggle with confusion about whether their relationship will lead to marriage.

The romance itself is not reinvented, but the storytelling takes an interesting turn through its use of flashbacks. These flashback portions take up a major part of the runtime and are smartly connected to what the lead pair is going through in the present.

The school-time portions are especially relatable. They feel very close to real life, with no exaggeration or cinematic drama. Humour is one of the film's biggest strengths. Almost every lighthearted scene lands well and creates genuine laugh moments. The comedy is placed at the right points in the story, keeping the film engaging and preventing it from slipping into melodrama.

The chemistry between Abhishan and Anaswara works naturally and adds charm to the film.

Overall, it's a fun and charming rom-com that may feel familiar, but the humour and moments make it worth watching.
